rationale: I read the complete held EO 13371 (70 FR 5041, Jan. 31, 2005): it amends EO 13285 (President's Council on Service and Civic Participation) by rewriting secs. 2(a) and 2(b) (mission and functions, including the President's Volunteer Service Award) and sec. 4(b) (the Council expires January 29, 2007 unless further extended); it has no term or savings clause of its own, and its effect exists only as text of EO 13285. I read the held texts of the later amendments to EO 13285: EO 13424 (72 FR 4409, Jan. 30, 2007) replaces sec. 4(b) so that the order 'shall expire on November 30, 2008' unless further extended, and EO 13471 (73 FR 51209, Sept. 2, 2008) sec. 2 replaces it again: 'Unless further extended by the President, this order shall expire on June 30, 2009.' EO 13471 adds a quorum rule but leaves EO 13371's secs. 2(a)-(b) text in place, so the order as amended, including EO 13371's rewrite, ran only to June 30, 2009. D6 self-check: EO 13424 and EO 13471 both post-date EO 13371 and replace only the sec. 4(b) date that EO 13371 had set (a partial supersession of EO 13371's sec. 2, taken alone, but they extended and then fixed the final expiry date for the entire order). The conclusion that the order expired depends on there being no further extension: a search of all held texts (6,652 Executive Order texts through EO 14425) for 13285 and for the Council's name finds only EO 13285, 13371, 13424 and 13471, so no held order extends, re-establishes or revokes-and-revives it after June 30, 2009. Residual risk: an extension that is not an Executive Order (the corpus holds only orders) is not excluded; and the exact expiry date is not adjudicated. The basis is the end date in EO 13471 sec. 2, not the machine ACT: record (which quotes only EO 13471's preamble). Provisional NO hypothesis only.
